name: acceptance-poll-primitive
description: Acceptance harness waits funnel through one shared primitive: scripts/acceptance/lib/poll.ts pollAcceptance (wrapper over SDK pollUntilTerminal) + WarrenHttp.sdkClient() for SDK waitForRun. pollAcceptance has a type-guard overload for nullable fetchRow narrowing. Fixed windows that assert a negative (e.g. 15's no-double-dispatch quiet window) are the only sanctioned sleeps; post-kill windows use waitForServerDown polls instead.

name: internalized-local-stub-via-path-shim
description: Stub-agent injection for the internalized local runtime (post-warren-413d): the claude-code adapter execs the bare name 'claude' inside bwrap, so acceptance shims it via PATH — prepend a shim dir (scripts/acceptance/lib/stub-agent/claude-code-path-shim.sh copied to <dir>/claude) to the booted warren's PATH via bootInProc extraEnv; profile.ts probes it with Bun.which and binds the dir into the sandbox. The burrow-with-stub.ts registry-override pattern only covers the legacy daemon path. Also: warren-seeded untracked drops (e.g. .warren/agent.json) must be git-clean'ed at seed_reset or their residue trips dropped_commit on no-commit runs (fixed in finalize-seed-reset.ts, warren-0f18).

name: internalized-engine-stub-strategy
description: Post-internalized-engine (warren-9a26) acceptance stub strategy: seed the stub agent with runtime=claude-code and prepend a fixture bin dir to PATH carrying a claude shim (claude-code-path-shim.sh, prompt-knob driven [mulch_id]/[mulch_ts]/[seed_id]/[sleep_ms]); on bwrap-less hosts also install a fake bwrap (bwrap-shim.sh) that applies --bind workspace/home mappings and execs the child — it must share the claude shim's bin dir because Bun.spawn resolves bare 'bwrap' against the composed sandbox PATH. Avoid mid-flight cancel in scenarios: cancel settles on the watchdog's 30s reconcile tick; use a short sleep knob + natural completion (reaps inline on the same code path).

name: docker-self-host-scenario
description: Scenario 42 (one-line self-host pin) pattern: docker-topology acceptance boots warren via raw 'docker run' with no security flags and WARREN_RUNTIME=docker; needs docker.sock + docker CLI bind mounts, data-dir bind at the SAME absolute path (path parity), port 8080 published so agent containers reach the host-gateway callback, and a stub agent image built FROM the control-plane image with the claude-code PATH shim COPYed over /usr/local/bin/claude and ENTRYPOINT reset to /usr/bin/env. First-boot token mint is scraped from docker logs via the mintedOperatorToken pino field.

Acceptance scenarios drift when a wire envelope is renamed: PR #963 renamed SpawnRunResponse.burrow -> sandbox but only nightly runs the acceptance suite, so scenarios 04/16 stayed red for days. Separately, scenario 42 needs a docker daemon and silently skips on hosts without one, so a red-42 nightly can only be diagnosed on the docker-capable nightly runner.
resolution: When renaming a wire shape, grep scripts/acceptance/scenarios for the old key, not just src/. Updated 04/16 assertions + unused response-interface fields to the sandbox envelope; full nightly set (minus docker-only 42) passes locally.
